merchant/30892.htm.text: Trader Enverun: Welcome, youngster. Our shop offers both magic items and more mundane supplies. We cater to not only magicians, but also to warriors seeking protection against magic -- and even ladies looking for pretty accessories... So many people come to our shop! We even have adventurers seekin…

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.
Ask about the Sword of Othelotte.

merchant/30892-1.htm.text: Trader Enverun: What, you haven't heard? Is this your first visit to Innadril? The Sword is the symbol of the Lord of Innadril. It is filled with history. Several decades ago, the water dragon Fafurion rose up and caused great devastation in these parts. Then Lionel, the hunter, he was just a young…

merchant/30892-pk.htm.text: Trader Enverun: Hey, you! Get out of my store! You'll drive away my respectable customers! Get out!

Q00338_AlligatorHunter/30892-02.htm.text: Trader Enverun: I'm sure you've heard the stories about Alligator Island?! Long ago, some alligators were brought over from Avella. They thrived and soon their numbers had multiplied to the point that the island they lived on became known as "Alligator Island." The residents of Heine are quite nerv…

links.text: "I will join the hunt for alligators."

Q00338_AlligatorHunter/30892-01.htm.text: Trader Enverun: I'm sure you've heard the stories about Alligator Island?! Long ago, some alligators were brought over from Avella. They thrived and soon their numbers had multiplied to the point that the island they lived on became known as "Alligator Island." The residents of Heine are quite nerv…

Q00338_AlligatorHunter/30892-04.html.text: Trader Enverun: Hey, partner! How is the alligator hunt coming along? Have you brought me any pelts ?

Q00338_AlligatorHunter/30892-03.htm.text: Trader Enverun: Wonderful! You should be honored! I don't ask just anyone to be my partner, but I like the cut of your jib! Now, let me explain how this is done. You must go to Alligator Island and kill as many alligators as you can. Bring their pelts back to me; I'll pay you 60 Adena for each one.

Q00338_AlligatorHunter/30892-05.html.text: Trader Enverun: What, no pelts to give me? Are you slacking? We need to make some Adena! Do you understand? Happy hunting!

Q00338_AlligatorHunter/30892-06.html.text: Trader Enverun: Great, how many pelts have you brought me? Here is your Adena. Would you like to keep hunting alligators?

Q00338_AlligatorHunter/30892-07.html.text: Trader Enverun: Fine, we'll settle up later... Whatever is best for you. I suppose you are off again to kill alligators? Happy hunting!

Q00338_AlligatorHunter/30892-08.html.text: Trader Enverun: That's great! Chances like this come along once in a lifetime, am I right? Happy hunting!

Q00338_AlligatorHunter/30892-09.html.text: Trader Enverun: Oh, that's not good! Just when the money started rolling in! Please, won't you reconsider?

Q00338_AlligatorHunter/30892-10.html.text: Trader Enverun: Well, you must have a good reason. Thank you for your hard work. Here is a token of our gratitude for all your help. Take care! Hopefully we will work together again some day, partner!
